info.name: OpenSearch REST API
info.description:
General OpenSearch 2.x REST API collection.

Defaults target the local stack in spring-template/infras/local/compose.yml (opensearch:2.11.1, security plugin disabled, analysis-icu installed).

Variables: baseUrl, index, alias, docId, pipeline, template, username, password.
Auth is "No Auth" because plugins.security.disabled=true. For a secured cluster, switch the collection auth to Basic ({{username}}/{{password}}) and use an https baseUrl.

Run "Indices > Create index" before the Documents and Search folders.

item.name: Cat
item.description: Human-readable _cat endpoints. Add format=json for JSON output.

request.description: Uses the analysis-icu plugin (icu_tokenizer + icu_folding) for Vietnamese / accent-insensitive text.
Source index must be read-only first: PUT /{{index}}/_settings {"index.blocks.write": true}

request.description: NDJSON body; must end with a newline. Same operations as OpenSearchService.bulk().
Accent-insensitive thanks to icu_folding: "bom tiem" matches "Bơm tiêm".
Mirrors OpenSearchService.search(List<String> indices, ...). Wildcards like products-* also work.
Pass the sort values of the last hit from the previous page.
Requires path.repo=/usr/share/opensearch/snapshots in the node config (not set in the local compose file).
